title: HTTP API
description: Endpoints a program calls over HTTP. An item of the work type `api` needs an end-to-end test that starts the real server and calls it, is called by the reviewer the way the author of a client would (the documented examples, then bad, missing, huge and repeated input, wrong methods and wrong credentials), and is scored on contract, errors, robustness and security against docs/API-CONVENTIONS.md. A milestone with such items is accepted where the product runs: on the deployed dev site when the stack deploys one, otherwise on a production build of the merged base, started on the machine the loop runs on.
choose: The product has endpoints that other programs call: a backend for an app, or an API of its own.
